title.zh: 抛体与圆周 · 一直在掉，但总掉不到地上
title.en: Projectiles & Circular Motion · Always Falling, Never Landing

desc.zh: 把速度劈成水平、竖直两份，各走各的；圆周运动需要不停“拽向圆心”；卫星就是水平速度大到掉下去的曲线总绕着地球转的炮弹。
desc.en: Split velocity into a horizontal and a vertical part that do not disturb each other; circular motion needs a steady pull toward the centre; a satellite is a cannonball whose fall keeps curving round the Earth.
